A QUICK BRIEFING

Good luck. You'll need it.

  1. Build it. Chat has 30 seconds to choose an attack, weakness and body using the commands on the cards.
  2. Hard mode. Bosses have more health, sweeping lasers and denser projectile rings. Windups last just 0.5 seconds, dropping to 0.38 seconds after mutation. Phase II adds a second bullet ring and charge wake projectiles.
  3. Fight it. WASD or arrows to move. Hold Space to shoot toward the boss. Tap Shift to dash through attacks; recharge takes 2 seconds.
  4. Command it. During the fight, vote !laser, !orbit or !charge every 10 seconds. The winner controls the boss’s attack pattern. No votes keeps the current attack.
  5. Play a wildcard. Every 12 combat seconds, vote !rage (4s speed boost), !barrage (12 bullets), !shield (4s boss armor), !scramble (2.5s reversed controls), !heal (one heart), or !cleanse (clear bullets). Healing and cleansing have two uses each per round. Empty ballots do nothing; ties use the first tied command. Wildcards pause during mutation.
  6. Evolve it. Each viewer’s first valid command counts once per round. Ducks, dogs and cats evolve at 8 and 16 unique voters by default. Vote !duck, !dog or !cat for the body. Change these goals before a round. Form II attacks 10% more often, gives shorter warnings, fires denser rings and adds four projectiles to every attack. Form III attacks 20% more often, cuts warnings further, sweeps lasers faster, and adds ten projectiles to every attack. Projectiles and charges also speed up by 8% and 16% respectively. Combat pauses for two seconds during each evolution; boss health is preserved.
  7. Mutate it. At half health, combat pauses for an 8-second vote: !split adds splitting projectiles, !twin echoes each attack with a new warning, !haste makes attacks faster. The winner lasts for the rest of the fight.
  8. Settle it. Defeat the boss before 60 seconds. Defeating the boss earns a victory. If time expires while you are alive, the result celebrates survival and notes that the boss is undefeated. Losing all health gives chat a knockout win. Community score = survival seconds × 100 + damage to you × 25.

Practice works without Twitch. Live mode counts each account once per trait, including updated choices. Build ties use the first listed option. Attack ties keep the current attack when tied; otherwise the first listed option wins. Mutation ties and empty mutation ballots default to the first tied option (!split if no votes).

For OBS, enable Stream view and use Window Capture on this window. Keep the game focused for keyboard play.
